    About this item

    • Get a skin friendly trim with the help of SkinProtect Comb. It gives you a comfortable clean look while providing extra skin protection. The comb guides the skin away from the blades for a close, smooth trim
    • Get a perfect but protective trim with self-sharpening steel blades. Stainless Steel Blades for long-lasting sharpness as you get on day 1 of purchase
    • Skin friendly rounded tips for smooth skin contact to prevent scratches and irritation, the blades have rounded tips for smoother skin contact to protect against nicks and cuts.

    • DuraPower technology to reduce friction on the blades, preserve the motor and keep a longer-lasting battery life going 4 times longer. Comes with a Charging Indicator.

        Important information

        Safety Information:

        Keep away from children.

        Product description

        1. Get a skin friendly trim with the help of SkinProtect Comb. It gives you a comfortable clean look while providing extra skin protection. The comb guides the skin away from the blades for a close, smooth trim. 2.  Get a perfect but protective trim with self-sharpening steel blades. Stainless Steel Blades for long-lasting sharpness as you get on day 1 of purchase. 3. Skin friendly rounded tips for smooth skin contact to prevent scratches and irritation, the blades have rounded tips for smoother skin contact to protect against nicks and cuts.  4. Up to 30 minutes of cordless ensures 3 weeks of usage* in a single charge of 8 hours. Comes with a USB charging cable for flexible charge. (*Basis 5mins of usage for 1 trim and 2 trims per week) 5. DuraPower technology to reduce friction on the blades, preserve the motor and keep a longer-lasting battery life going 4 times longer. Comes with a Charging Indicator.  6. Choose beard lengths of 3-7mm or the zero trim look 7. Build to last with 2-year product warranty, Maintenance-free and No oil required 8. Easy to hold and use. Designed to help you trim those hard-to-reach areas. 9. The trimmer is easy to maintain and clean. Detach the head and rinse it under the tap for easy cleaning then dry it and put it back.

            About this Item

            • Get a skin friendly trim with the help of SkinProtect Comb. It gives you a comfortable clean look while providing extra skin protection. The comb guides the skin away from the blades for a close, smooth trim
            • Get a perfect but protective trim with self-sharpening steel blades. Stainless Steel Blades for long-lasting sharpness as you get on day 1 of purchase
            • Skin friendly rounded tips for smooth skin contact to prevent scratches and irritation, the blades have rounded tips for smoother skin contact to protect against nicks and cuts.
            • Up to 30 minutes of cordless ensures 3 weeks of usage* in a single charge of 8 hours. Comes with a USB charging cable for flexible charge. (*Basis 5mins of usage for 1 trim and 2 trims per week). Build to last with 2-year product warranty, Maintenance-free and No oil required
            • DuraPower technology to reduce friction on the blades, preserve the motor and keep a longer-lasting battery life going 4 times longer. Comes with a Charging Indicator.

            Product description

            1. Get a skin friendly trim with the help of SkinProtect Comb. It gives you a comfortable clean look while providing extra skin protection. The comb guides the skin away from the blades for a close, smooth trim. 2.  Get a perfect but protective trim with self-sharpening steel blades. Stainless Steel Blades for long-lasting sharpness as you get on day 1 of purchase. 3. Skin friendly rounded tips for smooth skin contact to prevent scratches and irritation, the blades have rounded tips for smoother skin contact to protect against nicks and cuts.  4. Up to 30 minutes of cordless ensures 3 weeks of usage* in a single charge of 8 hours. Comes with a USB charging cable for flexible charge. (*Basis 5mins of usage for 1 trim and 2 trims per week) 5. DuraPower technology to reduce friction on the blades, preserve the motor and keep a longer-lasting battery life going 4 times longer. Comes with a Charging Indicator.  6. Choose beard lengths of 3-7mm or the zero trim look 7. Build to last with 2-year product warranty, Maintenance-free and No oil required 8. Easy to hold and use. Designed to help you trim those hard-to-reach areas. 9. The trimmer is easy to maintain and clean. Detach the head and rinse it under the tap for easy cleaning then dry it and put it back.
